# agriclimr

The agriclimr package is designed for agrometeorological calculations
and agricultural climate analysis.

## Installation

You can install the development version of agriclimr from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("joaobtj/agriclimr")
```

Alternatively, you can install it via R-Universe:

``` r

install.packages("agriclimr", repos = c("https://joaobtj.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

## Documentation

For comprehensive theoretical guides, mathematical formulations, and
detailed function references, please visit the official documentation
site:

👉 <https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/>

Step-by-step tutorials and fully reproducible examples are available
under the Articles section in both English and Portuguese.

# Package index

## Solar Geometry

Astronomical solar position and day length calculations.

- [`estimate_solar_noon()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/estimate_solar_noon.md)
  : Estimate Solar Noon
- [`estimate_sunrise()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/estimate_sunrise.md)
  : Estimate Sunrise Time
- [`estimate_sunset()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/estimate_sunset.md)
  : Estimate Sunset Time
- [`estimate_daylength()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/estimate_daylength.md)
  : Estimate Astronomical Day Length (Photoperiod)

## Temperature

Hourly temperature estimation and conversion.

- [`estimate_hourly_temp()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/estimate_hourly_temp.md)
  : Reconstruct Hourly Temperatures from Daily Extrema
- [`daily_to_hourly_temp()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/daily_to_hourly_temp.md)
  : Expand Daily Temperature Data Frame to Hourly Scale

## Relative Humidity

Hourly relative humidity estimation and conversion.

- [`estimate_hourly_rh()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/estimate_hourly_rh.md)
  : Estimate Hourly Relative Humidity from Daily Metrics
- [`daily_to_hourly_rh()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/daily_to_hourly_rh.md)
  : Disaggregate Daily Weather Data to Hourly Relative Humidity

## Leaf Wetness Duration

Leaf wetness duration modeling.

- [`estimate_lwd_rh()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/estimate_lwd_rh.md)
  : Estimate Leaf Wetness Duration (LWD)
- [`daily_to_hourly_lwd()`](https://joaobtj.github.io/agriclimr/reference/daily_to_hourly_lwd.md)
  : Disaggregate Daily Weather Data to Hourly Leaf Wetness Duration
